newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUX ends officially at 5,978.86,up 5.49pts.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUX ends officially at 5,978.86,up 5.49pts.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) revised its preliminary figure for the change in the BUX index on Wednesday to a 5.49 point rise to 5,978.86 points from a 12.46 point drop.
According to the official figures, the BUX index finished at 5,978.86 points, up 0.09 percent or 5.49 points, the BSE said in a statement.
Spot share turnover totalled 3.06 billion forints.
